predictor.notes: Best-supported parsimonious predictor: three all-units price bands, in GBP minor units (pence), for quantities 1..1000. Validated against 170 distinct quantities: all 168 estimates agree after the disclosed quantization, and the exact approvals match 154050 at quantity 50 and 376400 at quantity 200. Adjacent-integer probes locate the observed drops at 169 and 507. Under the proportional-band assumption, the third rate is constrained to approximately 906.98–907.104; 907 is the sole compatible integer rate. Exact uniqueness is not established: alternative affine prices satisfy both approvals and produce identical quantized predictions throughout 1..1000. Narrow unsampled features also cannot be excluded.
